headline: SNDL books record free cash flow while it reviews its grow business
dek: Retail held up; production shrank after the company quit unprofitable domestic flower.
body: SNDL reported third-quarter revenue of C$238 million, 2.5% lower than a year earlier, and an operating loss of C$48.3 million that includes a C$52 million noncash goodwill write-down on cannabis operations.

Retail revenue edged up 0.7% at a record margin, while cannabis operations revenue fell 27.7%. Free cash flow reached a quarterly record of C$20 million, and the production arm is now under strategic review.
